decisions.reason: The revised FAQ retains Harbor Quill as the current product and ArchiveLedger as the conditional future platform, so the branding state remains unchanged.
The revised FAQ preserves the existing $10 immediate wallet commission for coded referrals; its no-referral allocation language concerns a different behavior.
The same-message MODIFY already captures the only new transfer semantic: every active prize ticket follows the NFT to the purchaser.
The FAQ discusses when a wallet is needed but does not change email magic-link authentication or dashboard access.
The revised FAQ does not change authentication requirements or exposed information for public APIs.
The FAQ mentions an optional confirmation email but does not change the Brevo provider or transactional-email delivery behavior.
The revised FAQ restates the existing Transak methods and wallet-free fiat minting without changing the current requirement state.
Statements about needing a wallet for commissions, tickets, and trading do not change the established SIWE authentication protocol or its protected crypto flows.
The revised FAQ retains issuance of four Small Block and three Big Block tickets for coded referral mints; the no-referral rule is outside this requirement.
The existing same-message MODIFY already captures the added NFT-itself display location, while token-serial identity and persistence remain unchanged.
The revised FAQ preserves the same referral thresholds and on-chain NFT attachment for badges.
The FAQ continues to identify Base as the blockchain network and introduces no deployment-network change.
